# An unknown argument close in spelling to an in-scope identifier gets a
# "did you mean" suggestion instead of the full identifier list.

! muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

Error:
  GET / F(reqest)
          ^^^^^^
$WORK/template.gohtml:1:21: unknown argument reqest; did you mean request?
-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET / F(reqest)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))
